## About this appendix

This appendix collects the problem sets and practice exams I worked through for 18.02, grouped by part. Each entry links to a PDF holding the original MIT statement together with my handwritten solution. It is the practical, *operational* counterpart to the lecture notes: evidence that the concepts were not just understood, but applied.

For the problem sets, only **Part B** (the written problems) is reproduced: Part A referenced exercises from the course textbook, which is not part of the OCW materials and is not reproduced here. Some earlier assignments predate my switch to a tablet workflow and are not yet digitized; they will be added here as they are scanned.
